fields.label: What It Is
fields.description: What the founder calls this standing cost - Tiền thuê văn phòng, Lương Minh, Adobe. It becomes the payment's description, so write it the way it should read on the overhead log.

fields.label: Amount Each Month
fields.description: What it usually is. A month that came out different is corrected on the payment, not here - changing this restates what the company is committed to from now on, and never restates a payment already recorded.

fields.label: Day Of The Month
fields.description: The day it usually falls. 31 means month end and lands on the 28th in February - a payment stays inside the month it belongs to.

fields.label: First Month
fields.description: Any day in the first month it runs. Agreed on the 20th still means that whole month.

fields.label: Last Month
fields.description: Any day in the last month it runs. Leave empty while it is still running.

fields.label: Paused
fields.description: Stops it coming due without deleting what the company used to pay for. The payments already recorded from it stay exactly as they are.
